label: trappe
prompt: Draw ONE original native whole-object PNG sprite for the Yautja homeworld fan game La Longue Chasse, a lore-compatible ORIGINAL design, not a canonical film-prop assertion. The visual family has charcoal porous basalt/dark gunmetal, worn antique-bronze chamfered angular reinforcement, fine restrained geometric carving, small contained amber fittings, realistic prerendered2.5D materials, warm neutral top-left light. Readable silhouette at small game size. Three-quarter isometric, front and right side visible, camera down25-30degrees. One connected object only, all tips,base and attachments entirely visible. Keep it modestly sized centrally on the square native canvas with vast20percent empty TRANSPARENT padding on every side. Preserve native emitted dimensions. Exact alpha0 everywhere outside physical silhouette including every edge; no haze/bloom,cast shadow,ground patch,backdrop/checkerboard,scenery,text/letters/numbers/logos,people/creatures,grid/atlas/repeated views or cropping. Static candidate only; no gameplay or art admission implied. SUBJECT: one independent CLOSED ALIEN GROUND ACCESS HATCH set into its own shallow rigid octagonal frame. A low flat angular dark-metal cover plate with worn bronze edge reinforcement,two heavy attached hinges,one recessed locking handle and a narrow amber mechanical status aperture. Camera3quarter looking down30degrees so its top walking surface reads as a horizontal floor hatch,not a vertical door or floating shield. Small integral frame depth and underside lip only, no surrounding pavement square,no building,no open hole or underground room. Clearly CLOSED static state,one complete object only; no second open copy,no multi-frame sheet. Native plate engraving echoes basalt undercity paving without copying its texture tile. All frame corners and hinges fully inside generous transparent margins.
